locations.title: Hall of Ablution Statues
locations.description:
**Clue:** _"Women are blind to male advances, but the poor shall take their chances to give their lord their bounty sown, so that soon the wine may flow"_

**Solution:** The clue refers to the direction the statues should face. Turn the 2 female statues to face each other. Then turn the man on the horse (lord) to face the lady, and turn the poor men to face the lord.

media.title: Resident Evil Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2021.05.08 - 16.40.06.08

locations.title: Special Chambers Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:** 
- First, use the nearby Pipe Bomb to break through the crumbling wall and reveal the lit brazier. 
- Next, shoot (or melee) the left most hanging brazier so it hits the flame.
- Finally, hit both the left & right braziers so that they swing and collide with each other. 

The metal fence will then recede.

locations.title: Doll Woman
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Examine the doll's right shoulder to obtain the [Winding Key](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80163)
    - Use the key to activate the [Music Box](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80173)
- Examine the doll's left hand to obtain the [Blood Covered Ring](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80164)
    - Wash off the blood in the [Sink](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80168)
- Examine the doll's mouth and use [Tweezers](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80174) to retrieve the film
    - View it with the [Projector](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80176)
- Use [Scissors](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80177) to cut through the doll's chest bandage and find a [Brass Medallion](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=437246)
- Examine the doll's left eye and right arm to find two other symbols.
    - Use the Medallion and symbols to unlock the [Sealed Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80169)

locations.title: Sluice Gate Controls
locations.description:
You'll need to restore the power by completing the [Windmill Turntable Puzzle](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-village/maps/the-village?locationIds=80270) first.

**Hint:** Check the diagram next to the console

**Solution:** Notice that the diagram has a single black (broken) light. Rotate the diagram so that the broken light is to the right, just like the real console. Then input the colors.
